summary: Titan Mining Corp filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing positive metallurgical results for its Kilbourne Graphite Project, including validation of the concentrator flowsheet and production of battery-grade spherical graphite. The release discusses technical progress in the feasibility study and does not involve any special situation such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or other corporate event. No deal terms are present as this is a purely operational update.
